set.body: Evidence: rank-specific NDArray.apply and MutableNDArray.apply/update construct an IArray for every scalar access, and Layout.physicalIndex consumes it through the arbitrary-rank loop. JMH GC profiling measures about 152 B per rank-two read: 9,961,486 B for a 256-side traversal and 159,383,772 B for a 1024-side traversal, at about 15.4-15.6 ns per read. Implement direct rank-one through rank-four physical-index methods with failure-only error construction, while retaining at(IArray) and updateAt(IArray) for arbitrary ranks. Cover contiguous, offset, reversed, transposed, broadcast, empty, wrong-rank, and out-of-bounds cases on JVM and Scala.js. Acceptance: scalar read and mutable update preserve existing exception semantics and locality; normalized allocation is zero or profiler noise per access; row-major scalar traversal has no regression and targets at most 5 ns per read; optimized Scala.js uses direct typed-array indexed access.
set.title: Eliminate rank-specific scalar indexing allocation
